opening_title: junit-xml output attribute can be too big to handle with -vv

expected_outcome.rationale: A large assertion diff with -vv makes a JUnit XML failure message attribute too large for downstream parsers. #12204 describes traceback growth from repeated fixture exceptions, not XML attribute sizing. The two-line test is a standalone reproduction and pytest 8.1.1 is stated; package list and OS version are absent. Bug is proposed for parser breakage; enhancement or question is also defensible for the requested output limit.
